verdict.rationale: LegalZoom is a SaaS legal-services platform, and such a product could plausibly offer an API or headless automation, so the axis applies. The evidence pack documents only web-dashboard services (formation, registered agent, compliance alerts) and an llms.txt file that gives guidance to AI crawlers. Nothing shows an API, CLI, or headless or CI mode, so the verdict is none.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation
